rooms.list.statement: SELECT id, name, seats FROM rooms ORDER BY name LIMIT 50

availability.day.statement: SELECT room_id AS room, slot AS hour FROM bookings WHERE day = ?1 AND cancelled_at IS NULL ORDER BY room_id, slot LIMIT 500

bookings.day.statement: SELECT b.booking_ref AS ref, b.room_id AS room, b.slot AS hour, b.title AS title, coalesce(s.display, 'A colleague') AS booked_by, b.user_id = ?1 AS mine, b.checked_in_at AS checked_in_at FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.day = ?2 AND b.cancelled_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.room_id, b.slot LIMIT 500

bookings.mine.statement: SELECT booking_ref AS ref, room_id AS room, day, min(slot) AS start, count(*) AS hours, title FROM bookings WHERE user_id = ?1 AND day >= ?2 AND cancelled_at IS NULL GROUP BY booking_ref ORDER BY day, start LIMIT 50

bookings.recent.statement: SELECT b.booking_ref AS ref, b.room_id AS room, b.day AS day, min(b.slot) AS start, count(*) AS hours, b.title AS title, coalesce(s.display, 'A colleague') AS booked_by, max(b.created_at) AS created_at, max(b.cancelled_at) AS cancelled_at FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.user_id = b.user_id GROUP BY b.booking_ref ORDER BY max(coalesce(b.cancelled_at, b.created_at)) DESC LIMIT 10

bookings.create.guard: Not booked. The room or the day is not on the board, the span is not 1 to 4 whole hours between 08:00 and 18:00, or someone holds one of those hours.
bookings.create.statement:
INSERT INTO bookings (booking_ref, room_id, day, slot, user_id, title, created_at)
WITH RECURSIVE span(slot) AS (SELECT ?4 UNION ALL SELECT slot + 1 FROM span WHERE slot + 1 < ?4 + min(?5, 4))
SELECT printf('%s/%s/%d/%d', r.id, ?3, ?4, ?7), r.id, ?3, span.slot, ?1, ?6, ?7
FROM rooms r, span
WHERE r.id = ?2
  AND date(?3) IS ?3 AND ?3 >= date(?7 / 1000, 'unixepoch', '-1 day')
  AND ?4 = CAST(?4 AS INTEGER) AND ?5 = CAST(?5 AS INTEGER)
  AND ?4 >= 8 AND ?5 BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND ?4 + ?5 <= 18
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.room_id = ?2 AND b.day = ?3 AND b.slot >= ?4 AND b.slot < ?4 + ?5 AND b.cancelled_at IS NULL)

bookings.cancel.guard: Nothing to cancel. The booking is not yours, or it is already cancelled.
bookings.cancel.statement: UPDATE bookings SET cancelled_at = ?3 WHERE booking_ref = ?1 AND user_id = ?2 AND cancelled_at IS NULL

staff.me.statement: SELECT display FROM staff WHERE user_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

staff.name.statement: INSERT INTO staff (user_id, display) VALUES (?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET display = excluded.display

panel.checkin.guard: No booking holds this room at this hour, or it is already checked in.
panel.checkin.statement: UPDATE bookings SET checked_in_at = ?4 WHERE room_id = ?1 AND day = ?2 AND slot = ?3 AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND checked_in_at IS NULL
